usageNotes: Lists all firewall IP aliases defined at the container level for a specific LXC guest. These aliases are container-scoped (not cluster- or datacenter-wide) and can be referenced by name in the container's firewall rules to simplify rule management. Requires VM.Audit on the target VMID; the node must be reachable and the container must exist.

examples.summary: List firewall aliases for LXC container 110 on node pve1

tips: Each alias entry includes a digest field — pass this digest when creating or updating aliases to guard against concurrent modifications.
Aliases defined here are container-scoped; they are not visible to other containers or the datacenter firewall unless also defined at those levels.
If the container's firewall is not enabled, aliases still exist in config but have no active effect on traffic.
